reason: My doctor said my magnesium could be low, and $24.99 for a first box with a named lab report and a money-back guarantee is cheap enough to try once. I would buy one box at the launch price, not two.
objection: Will I actually feel a difference? And I would have to finish all 30 sachets before the guarantee counts, so I am out a month either way.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing the lab report for a real batch before I pay, or a price above about $35 for one box would flip me to no.
